whenToUse: A driving school with courses by licence type, a pace-based weeks-to-test estimate, instructors and sign-up.
Schools that compare courses in a table and carry the choice into a sign-up form.
avoidWhen: A car garage or wash — use site-autoservice-01.
A general online course — use site-course-01.
a11y: Price and weeks-to-test changes are announced via aria-live and status regions; motion respects motion-reduce.
The age check error should stay visible next to the birth date field.
